newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Tietmeyer says sees no change in Buba rate policy.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer says sees no change in Buba rate policy.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said on Monday that he did not see any change in Bundesbank interest rate policy.

"As far as continental Europe is concerned nobody has given any hint they will increase rates and the Bundesbank is following a steady policy," Tietmeyer told journalists at the monthly G-10 meeting here.
"I do not see any change for the Bundesbank for the foreseeable future," Tietmeyer said commenting on the situation of European interest rates following the recent rate rise in the U.S.
Tietmeyer noted the interest rate situation in Europe differed from country to country and referred to the public dispute in Britain over a rate rise.
"You know there is a dispute over some rise or not in the U.K., but I can't predict it."
